clip.probe_clip: C(g) applied algebraically with identical formula on detached probe gradients

prediction_models.Mgeom_PRIMARY: pred g_j^+ = g_j + H_j s_t (a0g._hvp math-SDPA proxy), then real C re-clip; p_mu = mean_dev[C(g_j+H_j s_t) - c_j]
prediction_models.MnoJ_ablation: pred Delta c = mean_dev[H_j s_t], clip transform ignored (ablation only)
prediction_models.ordering: predictions written to disk BEFORE audit endpoint gradients are computed (order_index logged)

shadow_update.U_map: U(g; common_state): real clip -> moments -> bias correction (next cumulative step) -> P -> r=P*m_hat -> s=-eta_next*r - eta_next*wd*theta'; pure algebraic, clone tensors only, never steps real optimizer
shadow_update.common_state: post-update real m/v, next step count, arm next eta, theta'=theta_t+s_t
shadow_update.p_U: mean_dev[U(g_j+H_j s_t) - U(g_j)] (per-probe nonlinear U BEFORE averaging)
shadow_update.stop_v_ablation: m updates with new gradient, P fixed from pair-baseline g (artificial diagnostic, never an optimizer candidate)

tracking_readout.hat_mu: mean audit c_j at anchor theta_t
tracking_readout.K_V: Delta V + W_total (exact readout remainder, NOT guaranteed positive; not renamed curvature penalty)
